name: Trödelmarkt am SELGROS Köln-Butzweilerhof
facts: under a large roof, shelter in bad weather
a wide range of second-hand and new goods
at the Köln-Nord motorway junction, between the junction and the city centre
parking in the surrounding business park
notes: Only one date in the window, 18 Oct; nothing later published. The organiser calls it a new location. 'Eintritt frei' is from the site-wide Melan header, hence fee 0. Organiser writes 'S-Bahn: 5'; recorded as 'line 5'. Coordinates from Nominatim for Von-Hünefeld-Straße 100 (the SELGROS store).

description.de: Ein Trödelmarkt beim SELGROS am Butzweilerhof, am Kreuz Köln-Nord, von 11 bis 18 Uhr. Ein großes Dach schützt Stände und Besucher auch bei schlechtem Wetter; angeboten werden Trödel und Neuware. Erreichbar mit der Linie 5 und dem Bus 139; der Eintritt ist frei.
description.en: A second-hand market at the SELGROS by Butzweilerhof, at the Köln-Nord junction, open 11 to 6. A large roof keeps stalls and visitors dry in bad weather, with second-hand and new goods on offer. Line 5 and bus 139 stop nearby, and entry is free.
